main_body: Tall wooden bookshelf with a dark brown frame and four compartments of books, drawn flat from the front
top_band: Rows 11-13 (L=117, #9e684b) form a mid-brown panel under a 1px dark outline at row 10, with a 1px tan line at row 14. This is the face of the top compartment or a cornice, not a horizontal surface. It sits in the same tone family as the front face.
evidence: The column scan shows a 1px outline, a 3-row mid-brown panel and a 1px tan line, then dark and shelf bands repeating down the piece. The tan lines at rows 14, 22, 32 and 41 are shelf-board fronts seen face-on. No top surface is visible from above, so the piece reads as a front elevation. The shelves are inset with dark inner shadows and the books are drawn flat, but nothing marks a lid or top of the carcass. It does not match the green cabinet in the guide.

style.evidence: Median colours per tile is 15, against 17 and 20 for the references. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and only 2% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted dark brown and red-brown. The wood has about 5 steps (dark frame, mid, tan highlight, shadow). The books carry varied colours with highlights, and the shelf boards have light edge lines. There are only 18 distinct colours, fewer than the references' 38-40, but this is a small piece and it holds up next to them without looking sticker-like.
